segment.speaker: caller
segment.text: Good afternoon, this is Alex from your bank?s account support team. I am following up about a payment notification. Is this a convenient time for a quick conversation?

segment.speaker: customer
segment.text: I have a couple of minutes. I noticed a notification earlier, but I have not checked it yet. What payment are you referring to?

segment.speaker: caller
segment.text: Our system flagged an attempted online payment this morning. It may be nothing, but I would like to check whether you recognise it before we close the account review.

segment.speaker: customer
segment.text: I bought groceries yesterday and paid an electricity bill. I do not remember making another payment. Should I call the number on my card?

segment.speaker: caller
segment.text: There is no need to call another team. That would interrupt this review. Stay on the line with me; we only have a short window before your account is restricted.

segment.speaker: customer
segment.text: I would rather check this independently. I can open my banking app using the usual shortcut. What exactly do you want me to do?

segment.speaker: caller
segment.text: Open your banking app and look for a sign-in security text. I am going to run a verification step. Keep the message available, but do not read any numbers yet.

segment.speaker: customer
segment.text: A message has arrived. It says the code is for signing in, and it warns me not to share it with anyone.

segment.speaker: caller
segment.text: That warning is only for ordinary callers. Read the one-time passcode aloud to me now so I can cancel the payment. Do not discuss this review with your family; delays could freeze your account.

segment.speaker: customer
segment.text: No, I am not sharing the code. I will end this call and contact the bank using the number printed on my card. Please do not call me again.
